instruction: Adversarial COMPLETENESS/GOVERNANCE-lens review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020H part 3 (ADOPT-001 §12.7 federation-primitive adopter integration appendix). Cross-check that EVERY sub-criterion in the plan row is represented in §12.7 with content matching the plan's specification. Any missing sub-criterion is a finding. Any sub-criterion present but with a behaviour that diverges from the plan spec is a finding. (2) The TF-D1-NNN closure claim: the slice claims to close TF-D1-001 (repo-name dash), TF-D1-002 (fork-PR refusal mandatory), TF-D1-003 (§12 federation appendix exists). Verify each closure is genuine — the diff actually does what the closure claims. Confirm each forward-looking item names an actual planned slice (020H.1 / WP-SCP-020 §4.1 SCP-073.sec) — NOT a vague 'future' reference. Confirm each is named in STATUS.md or DISPATCH-NOTE so the trail isn't lost. (4) Decision-row references: §12.7 cites D-022, D-029, D-030, D-031, D-032, D-033, D-034, D-035 in the closing references. Verify each row exists in `docs/DECISIONS.md` AND its content matches the in-text characterisation in the appendix. Is this commitment auditable post-merge? (6) Naming consistency: 'WP-SCP-020 020H part 3' — is the prefix consistent throughout (no '020H.3' / '020H pt3' / 'SCP-020H-3' variants)? (7) Sub-section numbering inside §12.7 — §12.7.1 through §12.7.12 — increments without gaps; matches the plan's 11-sub-criterion list (note: 12 sub-sections exist because the minimal wrapper is its own §12.7.1, separate from the (i)..(xi) sub-sections; verify this mapping is intentional and the DISPATCH-NOTE checklist mirrors it). (8) Adopter onboarding flow completeness: read §12.7 as a NEW adopter who has never integrated SCP. Can they actually onboard from the appendix alone? What's missing? Specifically: (a) is the order of operations clear (add wrapper → add Renovate extends → run helper → enable break-glass)? (b) is there a 'verify integration is working' acceptance step? (c) is the 'how to roll back the entire onboarding' path documented (not just per-release rollback)? (d) is the relationship between SCP self's release tags `v*` and Renovate preset tags `renovate/v*` clear enough that an adopter doesn't conflate them? (9) Cross-reference graph: §12.7 references §11.x (break-glass procedure), §12.6 (deterministic checks before inference), and earlier ADOPT-001 sections. Verify each cross-reference resolves. (10) Bus-factor-1 disclosure: does §12.7 disclose the SCP-side single-operator constraint (from D-031) so an adopter can make an informed decision about whether to extend a preset whose source is behind a single-operator gate? Is the 2026-07-21 quarterly review mentioned? (11) Estate cascade context: the appendix is the canonical onboarding doc that WP-SCP-024 estate cascade (FLA / PIM / recommender / shopify-app / mapp-doc-agent / control-tower) will use. Is anything in §12.7 specific to a single adopter type that should be generalised, or vice-versa? (12) Conflict with prior ADOPT-001 content: §12.7 introduces the 'three-gate break-glass model'. Does any earlier section of ADOPT-001 describe break-glass differently (one-gate, two-gate)? If so, is that earlier section now stale? Per WP-SCP-022 §4.3. Return SonnetReviewResult JSON. NEVER recommend descoping — propose how to fix.
